tools.name: get_as_of
tools.description: get_as_of is the issuer record as it stood on a date: an issuer by ticker, ISIN or LEI plus a date returns the signed record of that day — every field with its source and read date, the sealed disclosure lines of the market-year up to that date — signed by the node of the issuer's market and receipt

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI: the apex names the owning node and forwards to that node's regional door for the record summary.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Dated, URL'd disclosure events for an issuer since a date, served by the owning node's regional door.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market node on the roster (nodes.json, region on each), which are live, their regional doors and Agent Cards.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_as_of" is 822 chars, far longer than this server's median (129). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_events_since · Private data: get_as_of, resolve_issuer · Public sink: get_as_of.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_events_since · Private data: get_as_of, resolve_issuer · Public sink: get_as_of

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
